About Muhammad

Software Engineer and AI Researcher based in Pakistan, interested in the space where rigorous systems meet natural human interaction.

Building with intent

I work on scalable software, from mobile applications to backend systems, and I am currently exploring cloud architecture, system design, and DevOps.

My research interests sit closer to the human side of the stack: Speech AI, LLMs, and interfaces that make intelligent systems feel more useful, understandable, and personal.

This site is where I keep the trail visible: ideas from the notebook, courses in progress, and projects that became real enough to share.
